dedupe_keys.name: norges tilstand state of the nation 2025 condition grades of norwegian public buildings and infrastructure rif

description: Norges tilstand (State of the Nation) is a report series that the Norwegian association of consulting engineers, RIF, has published since 2010 as a systematic assessment of the condition of Norway's public buildings and infrastructure. The 2025 edition grades each area from 1 to 5, where 5 is like new with no special maintenance need, against a target grade of 4 for good standard, with arrows for the expected development over the next decade. The areas include municipal and county buildings, hospitals, state and defence estates, railways, airports, national, county and municipal roads, water supply, wastewater and stormwater, energy production and energy distribution. The report finds that only one area is expected to improve, estimates that bringing Norway's public buildings and infrastructure to good standard would cost 3,300 billion kroner, and calls for more investment in climate adaptation and prevention, better asset registers and cross-sector work. The report can be read free online; the site states all rights reserved. Caveats: grades are expert judgements by consulting engineers, not measured asset data. Coverage is Norway. It supports condition and ageing analysis across sectors and the choice of scenarios for climate adaptation investment; the related record is the ASCE Infrastructure Report Card.
